title: App Store Reviews & App Details
description: Get iPhone and iPad app details (rating, rating count, version history, price, size, genre, description, screenshots) and the most recent customer reviews (rating, title, text, app version, date) from Apple's App Store, in any country. Paste App Store links, app IDs or app names.

apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store links, numeric app IDs, or app names (the top search match is used). Up to 500 per run.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes such as us, gb, de (reviews are per country). Default: the country in the link, otherwise us. Up to 20.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Maximum reviews per app and country
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Most recent first. Apple's feed provides at most 500 per country. 0 = app details only.

includeAppDetails.title: Include app details
includeAppDetails.description: Also return one row of app details (rating, version, price, description...) per app and country.

app.title: App details
app.description: One app's details for one country.

store.seoTitle: App Store Reviews Scraper & App Details API
store.seoDescription: Apple App Store reviews and app details for any app and country: ratings, review text, versions, price, screenshots. Links, IDs or app names.
